newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil touch easier, diesel still strong.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil touch easier, diesel still strong.

text.p: NWE heating oil was very narrowly weaker because of easier futures, but diesel was strong. Activity was sparse with much of continental Europe on holiday.
"Germany has been the driver, but its on holiday so we don't expect much today," said one trader.
May IPE gas oil was 50 cents lower at $171.25 a tonne.
Diesel premiums were a touch stronger with May IPE +$16 cif Thames for 20kt done yesterday for May 1-10 dates.
"It was a tight window supply-wise," said one trader of the deal -- the equivalent of May IPE +$14 cif Le Havre. "We are now at $14 (bid) and $15 (offer basis Le Havre)," said another.
Diesel barges on Thursday were talked around May IPE +$12 fob ARA, although business was very slow.
Heating oil barges were equally quiet with offers steady at May IPE +$1 fob AR.
Heating oil cargo premiums were steady with DIN pegged at May IPE +$6.50 cif Germany and FOD $1 lower.
